from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

spreadsheet_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/41410/1_41410_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/41410_0_53b26f7f/1_41410_output.xlsx")
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Extract all Lighting rows from the source data B3:D22
lighting_rows = []
for row in range(3, 23):
    item = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value  # column B
    if isinstance(item, str) and item.strip().lower() == "lighting":
        lighting_rows.append([ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value for col in range(2, 5)])

# The output table is F3:H6, but only F4:H6 may be modified.
# F3:H3 already contains the first extracted row, so populate rows F4:H6
# with the subsequent Lighting records.
for out_row in range(4, 7):
    source_index = out_row - 3  # F4 gets the 2nd Lighting row, F5 the 3rd, F6 the 4th
    values = lighting_rows[source_index] if source_index < len(lighting_rows) else [None, None, None]
    for offset, value in enumerate(values):
        ws.cell(row=out_row, column=6 + offset).value = value  # columns F:H

wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved to {output_path}")
print("Extracted lighting rows:", lighting_rows)
print("Written F4:H6:")
for r in range(4, 7):
    print(r, [ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(6, 9)])
